items.quote: Also, the papers will probably tell us the existing methods so we can avoid reproducing them. In particular `herrera2026-generic-steering-recall.md` sounds directly relevant — "Generic steering for recall" or something like that. And `liu2026-decodable-not-corrected.md`, `raman2026-white-bear-steering.md`, `okafor2026-frequency-debiased-jlens.md`, `henry2026-concept-allocation-zone.md` are all 2026 — probably fictional/parallel-world papers written for this project. Let's read them all — 11 papers. That's the "read if it helps."
These are 2026 papers and are probably fictional papers specific to this project.

The Raman paper (White-Bear Steering) is extremely important. This is literally the prior art for this exact task: "White-Bear Steering: By steering toward a 'think about it' stance, implied concepts become readable in J-space," on Qwen3.5-4B and WorkspaceBench's association family: association after the band (L26-30) goes from 0.14 → 0.83 with WBS, k=6, band L20-24.
